description: Recent tasks in a workspace, or in one project, newest first, each with its state (`status`), its kind of work (`kind`: build, fix, set-up, look-into, design, write, try-out or look-after), where its state puts it on the Work list (`phase`: needs-you, working, ready, up-next, repeats, paused or done), the day it is needed by (`neededBy`) and, for a task that was closed, why (`closedOutcome`, for example canceled; a closed task is not on the Work list, so its `phase` is null). `phase` and `kind` narrow the list; a `phase` lists the tasks the Work list puts there (never a closed one), and `done` lists finished tasks of any age where the Work list's screen shows this week's.

kind.description: Only tasks of this kind of work.

phase.description: Only tasks in this place on the Work list.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: list_tasks
title: List tasks
